youngster_north.name: Boy
dialog: Do you raise Pokémon of different types?
A team that's all one type goes down together the moment it meets the type it's weak to.

ace_trainer_f.name: Trainer
dialog: I teach at the Trainers' School, so here's today's lesson.
Some moves care whether a Pokémon is male or female. Captivate only works on the opposite gender!

trainer.name: Taylor
trainer.dialogueBefore: Aroma Lady Taylor: The scent of the flowers brought you this way too? Let's see what sort of trainer you are.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Aroma Lady Taylor: A strong one, it turns out. Follow the scent north and you'll come to Floaroma Town.

trainer.name: Brandon
trainer.dialogueBefore: Bug Catcher Brandon: Hey, hey! Come and look at my Bug Pokémon!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bug Catcher Brandon: They grow up fast, they poison, they paralyse, and they're cute. Bugs are the best, honest!

trainer.name: Liv & Liz
trainer.dialogueBefore: Liv: We can beat this one in a single turn. Can't we, Liz?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Liv: ...This trainer is going to tell everybody about it, Liz.

trainer.name: Liv & Liz
trainer.dialogueBefore: Liz: We're the best in our whole class!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Liz: ...This trainer looks much too pleased about it, Liv.
